name: footer
description: Bottom-of-page footer with signature statement, link columns, and fine print. Site-wide component.
intent: Close the page gracefully. Offer a last chance to navigate or subscribe. Reinforce brand tone without competing with the main content.
whenToUse: Every page on tracyharris.co and every brand sub-site. Only page where it's optional is a single-focus opt-in funnel.

signature.description: Large serif statement at the top of the footer. Usually the brand tagline or a closing thought. Skippable for minimal pages.

newsletter.description: Email capture block. Optional. Posts to ActiveCampaign.

columns.description: Array of link columns. Each has a title + array of links.

social.description: Social icons. For Tracy Harris Co primary: Instagram only. Other brands may add LinkedIn, YouTube.

legal.description: Copyright line + links to privacy, terms.

variants.full: Signature + newsletter + columns + social + legal. Homepage, long pages.
variants.columns: Columns + social + legal only. Product pages.
variants.minimal: Logo + legal + social only. Funnel pages, checkouts.

ffb.signature: Build a business that lets you live.

avoid: Four or more columns cluttering the space. Two or three columns reads cleaner.
Repeating the top nav word-for-word. Footer is where secondary links live (privacy, terms, contact, press).
Heavy visuals, background images, patterns. Footer should feel like a calm exhale.

a11y.headings: Column titles as <h2> with proper hierarchy
a11y.contrast: All links must hit 4.5:1 against the footer background
